generationInputs.prompt: A realistic CD jewel case, cleanly lit with soft reflections and shadows, showcases a minimalist, retro-style vector artwork cover. The cover art features a multi-faceted, brilliant-cut peach stylized into a simplified graphic form with bold shapes and thick outlines, surrounded by a cloud of white vapor with soft, diffused edges. To the right of the peach, an upright, transparent medical eggplant with clear numerical markings and a white extended plunger, light blue needle cap, and thin metallic needle is also stylized into a simplified graphic form. The overall composition feels polished and editorial, like a conceptual product photo. A bold album title in a wide, rounded typeface is present, along with a fictional label name and logo in one corner.
